actual_runtime_findings.finding: Empty returns before MMIO; nonempty RX group mask and idle-only no-op clear occur once outside the receive loop. RC/RDR/errors survive.
The completed Wait statement precedes one fresh ISR read used for RDR eligibility, ICR command, error selection and idle return.
One typed no-op-seeded ICR write acknowledges only snapshot receive bits plus opted-in idle. ORE > PE > FE > NE returns before appending the sampled byte or returning buffer-full/idle success.
Clean observed RC is appended before idle completion. No extra read occurs after buffer fill. Boundary assignment is documented as best-effort; repeated already-set flags can coalesce.
Waker registration precedes arming and status recheck. Ready and Wait Drop mask the full RX event group; cancellation preserves unread flags/data and existing caller prefix.
ISR includes enabled native RXIDLE in RX pending, masks the full RX set and wakes. It does not consume RDR/ICR or hold a caller-buffer pointer. State has no new fields.

Native exact-read entry and check_read retire abandoned RX enables, including blocking/trait/combined/empty ordinary paths. Readiness and ordinary acknowledgment ignore idle; classic/DMA paths are preserved.
The documented zero-MMIO empty method deliberately performs no old-wait cleanup; a later nonempty or ordinary read, enabled RX event, or RX-owner Drop retires it.
Common RX mask includes idle before RX shutdown. TX/RX cleanup, live-peer clock/IRQ retention, dispatch guards and existing DMA leases remain per direction.
Configuration leaves RXIDLE initially disabled and TIMCR zero. No TIMARR/TIMCNT, DMA, low-power, ring or registry changes.

main_matrix.target_strategy: Serial shared existing main target; per-row actual artifacts and OUT_DIR retained before overwrite. Clean must use its own fresh target.
